desc_sample: Wait until JMESPath query Reservations[].Instances[].State.Name returns running for all elements when polling with ``describe-instances``. It will poll every 15 seconds until a successful state has been reached. This will exit with a return code of 255 after 40 failed checks.

Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``head-bucket``. It will poll every 5 seconds until a successful state has been reached. This will exit with a return code of 255 after 20 failed checks.

Wait until JMESPath query Table.TableStatus returns ACTIVE when polling with ``describe-table``. It will poll every 20 seconds until a successful state has been reached. This will exit with a return code of 255 after 25 failed checks.
